card.name: Cross-reference and instruction wording in labels
card.fires_on: Short linking or instruction words in drug-label text that point to another section or table, such as "see", "in", "Refer" and "Administer". Also seen after a cross-reference number or bracket.

modes.label: Section pointers
modes.description: The word "see" or "in" that introduces a cross-reference to another label section.

modes.description: Verbs that start a directive about administration or tables, such as Administer or Refer.

modes.description: Connectors such as "as" in lists of drug interactions or study measures.
